build_swin_transformer_backbone: build a SwinTransformer backbone with configurable depths, num_heads, and window_size for segmentation
create_swin_block_sequence: create a SwinBlockSequence stage with specified depth, window_size, and optional downsample module
test_shift_window_msa: test the ShiftWindowMSA module with cyclic shift and attention mask on input features
review_window_msa_relative_bias: review the WindowMSA class and its relative position bias table initialization and forward pass
summarize_swin_transformer_forward: summarize the SwinTransformer forward pass that returns multi-scale feature maps from all stages
